display_title: Digital Productivity Course Category: Office & Data — Cloud and Workflow Target Duration: 2 weeks (6 sessions × 105
problem: In 2026, most office work happens digitally — through email, cloud documents and collaboration tools. Yet most workers have no formal training in digital productivity. They use email chaotically, lose files, miss deadlines and waste hours on tasks that could be automated. This course fixes that in two weeks.
audience: Office workers who want to be more organised and productive
Small business owners who manage their own digital work
Students who need to organise assignments and research
Church, school and NGO administrators who handle digital communications
Anyone who feels overwhelmed by email, files and tasks
The learner has basic computer skills (typing, file management, internet) but has never used cloud-based productivity tools
entry_requirements: None, but Typing & Computer Basics is strongly recommended
A practice machine — provided at the academy
Basic computer skills — file management, typing, internet
Willingness to change habits and adopt new systems
